stem.en: A voter aged 88 has chosen to vote from home. What happens when the polling team visits?

text.en: The team sets up a voting machine beside the voter
The voter says the choice aloud to the team
The voter marks a ballot paper behind a screen
The voter signs a form so that a relative can vote later

explanation.en: The polling team brings a ballot paper and a screen. The voter marks the paper in private, and it goes into a sealed cover. No voting machine is used, and the vote stays secret.

hints.en: Home voting uses paper, not a machine.
A vote must stay secret, even at home.
